bounded_observations: Native notification action/phone labels and long contact/favorites labels use bounded small-screen ellipsization.
Settings, changelog, icon chooser, backup explanation and contact lists show ordinary scroll continuation; partial viewport rows are not treated as clipping defects.
Native status/navigation bars remain visible with appropriate light/dark contrast in the assigned captures.
limits: This is current-source visual review of only the assigned 52 frames; it does not establish whole269 visual approval.
Static capture review does not independently prove gestures, dialing, data mutation, accessibility focus or physical-device/audio/update behavior.
No publication authorization, signer/matching-key upgrade proof or physical Jelly Star testing is claimed.
